questionText: Draw a flowchart for serving a snack at the event based on the condition: If the amount donated by a visitor is more than GH¢ 200.00, serve meat pie and malt, otherwise serve biscuit and water.
modelAnswer: A standard flowchart structure starting with an Oval 'START', passing to a Parallelogram 'INPUT: Visitor's Donation Amount in GH¢', leading to a Diamond decision box 'Is Donation > GH¢ 200.00?'. If YES, leads to a Rectangle 'Serve Meat Pie and Malt'; if NO, leads to a Rectangle 'Serve Biscuit and Water'. Both branches converge to an Oval 'END'[cite: 84, 85].

questionText: State one function of each of the following components used in constructing a robot: (i) Gears (ii) Grippers (iii) Motors.
modelAnswer:
(i) Gears: Used to transmit power/motion, change the speed, or alter the direction of movement within the robot[cite: 85].
(ii) Grippers: Act as the hands of the robot, used to grasp, pick up, hold, or manipulate objects[cite: 85].
(iii) Motors: Actuators that convert electrical energy into mechanical energy to provide movement and drive the robot's parts[cite: 85].

questionText: Describe the term generation of computers in your own words.
modelAnswer: Refers to specific periods of technological advancement in computing history, characterized by a major fundamental change in hardware technology (such as vacuum tubes, transistors, or microprocessors) that made computers smaller, faster, cheaper, and more powerful[cite: 85].

questionText: List three file management practices that Dan should use to organize his work better.

questionText: A student plays a computer game for 5 hours every night and experiences headache, dry and blurry eyes. (i) What computing-related disorder is likely experienced? (ii) Explain it.
modelAnswer:
(i) Eye Strain / Computer Vision Syndrome (CVS)[cite: 85].
(ii) A condition resulting from focusing the eyes on a computer or digital display device for protracted periods without breaks, leading to dry eyes, headaches, blurred vision, and neck/shoulder pain due to screen glare and reduced blinking[cite: 85].

questionText: A student typed the title in ALL CAPS: BASIC EDUCATION CERTIFICATE EXAMINATION. (i) Which PowerPoint feature can fix it? (ii) Outline the steps.
modelAnswer:
(i) Change Case[cite: 85].
(ii) Steps: 1. Select the typed text. 2. Go to the Home tab on the ribbon. 3. In the Font group, click on the Change Case icon (Aa). 4. Select 'Capitalize Each Word' (or Title Case)[cite: 85].

questionText: Given examination marks in cells A2(85), B2(90), and C2(95): (i) Write an Excel formula for total mark; (ii) Write an Excel function for average mark; (iii) Write the symbol that must begin every formula or function.
modelAnswer:
(i) Total mark formula: `=A2+B2+C2` or `=SUM(A2:C2)`[cite: 86].
(ii) Average mark function: `=AVERAGE(A2:C2)`[cite: 86].
(iii) Symbol to begin: Equals sign (`=`)[cite: 86].

questionText: Calculate Total_Expenses = 12 * 200.00 + 150.00 + 7 * 23.00 using computer operator precedence.
